full_judgment: 3. The suit was decreed ex-parte on 22.04.1997. The appellants who were the defendants in the suit filed Title Appeal No. 446 of 1997 in the Court of District Judge, Chittagong out of time by 112 days. Along with the memorandum of appeal, an application was filed for condoning the delay. The learned District Judge rejected the prayer for condonation of delay by his order dated 16.03.1998 and thereby rejected the memorandum of appeal. Against the said order of the learned District Judge rejecting the prayer for condonation of delay, the appellants filed an application before the High Court Division under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure out of time by 583 days. Along with the revision application, a separate application was filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act for condoning the delay in filing the revision application. On such application, a Rule was issued calling upon the respondent to show cause as to why the delay in filing the revision application should not be condoned giving rise to Civil Rule No. 253(con) of 2000.
